lines: Status 286, 1:46 PM MT Nov 28. One thing waits on you: listen to Preview 14, attached, the opening alone, 13.8 seconds with sound. Say whether the ticks on the usage change, the Send sound and the shorter wait are right, and whether the typing still sounds harsh in this file as it is.

What changed against Preview 13 (decision 338), measured here in the delivered file's own sound. A tick on each press of the usage change, at 0.88 and 1.67 seconds, each peaking at -12.0 dB. The first key at 1.97 seconds, where it was 2.5. The keys untouched: the same ten files at the same level, -30.1 LUFS at their loudest three seconds, peak -15.0 dB. Halation's Send sound at 7.15 seconds in place of this build's own, peaking at -9.2 dB where the own one peaked at -8.0. Silence before the first tick, between the marks and on the build screen until the riser. The opening is 12.3 seconds long, was 12.8. The first letter stands while the menu is still fading, for a fifteenth of a second; that follows from the shorter wait. How any of it sounds is unknown here until you listen. Nothing was generated.
Sound credits stand at 7,420 of 10,000 and stay there: music 4,851, sound effects 2,569.

Since 1:25 PM. The render handoff for your PC had its last reading (decision 337): a fresh reader that saw none of the build says merge, no must-fix, 9 of 10. It is merged for its checks: the whole test run and the guard stills of the merged tree run on a helper machine now, and one 4K frame is drawn on it to prove that no pixel moved. It reaches the main branch when both come back, expected by 2:30 PM. No real graphics card has drawn anything yet; that is step 1 on your PC.

Phases 0 to 5 are complete. Phase 6, the films, in four steps. One: the opening's sound and timing change goes to the main branch after a fresh reviewer has read it; its builder's whole report is due 3:00 PM. Two: the render handoff reaches the main branch after its checks, then takes the new opening's frames and one more hosted proof, and then you get one file to follow. Three: the 4K render runs on your PC when you start it. Four: you receive With Prompt, Without Prompt, Portfolio Looping Video and Portfolio Screenshot.
Also at work: the one value mend for the first load's lost picture on Macs (open item 295), its paired proof due 2:30 PM.
Still open with you, unchanged: the two what-ifs of Preview 12 (the sand mound leaving, fall's faces going out) and the level line's mend stay off the film until you say yes.
Not verified: the sound as heard, a real desktop graphics card, a phone, Safari, Firefox, a real Apple chip for item 295.
phase 6: 65.93 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 65.93 h used of 12.00 h allowed
